SELECT f.fackey,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.asrkey) AS total_assess,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.suicrisk IN ('High','Severe') OR (a.mental_health_scores->'depression'->>'phq9_score')::numeric > 15 OR (a.mental_health_scores->'anxiety'->>'gad7_score')::numeric > 15 THEN a.asrkey END) AS highrisk
FROM facilities f
JOIN encounters e ON e.facid = f.fackey
JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON ab.abkey = e.abref
JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk a ON a.asrkey = ab.abkey
GROUP BY f.fackey
LIMIT 5;

WITH hr AS (
  SELECT e.facid,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.asrkey) AS total_assess,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.suicrisk IN ('High','Severe') OR (a.mental_health_scores->'depression'->>'phq9_score')::numeric > 15 OR (a.mental_health_scores->'anxiety'->>'gad7_score')::numeric > 15 THEN a.asrkey END) AS highrisk
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN assessmentbasics ab ON ab.abkey = e.abref
  JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk a ON a.asrkey = ab.abkey
  GROUP BY e.facid
),
pfis AS (
  SELECT e.facid,
    AVG(CASE asd.funcimp WHEN 'Severe' THEN 3 WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Mild' THEN 1 END) AS pfis
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON asd.asdkey = e.abref
  GROUP BY e.facid
),
frai AS (
  SELECT f.fackey,
    AVG(CASE f.support_and_resources->>'community_resources' WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 END) AS frai
  FROM facilities f
  GROUP BY f.fackey
)

FROM hr
JOIN pfis ON pfis.facid = hr.facid
JOIN frai ON frai.fackey = hr.facid
WHERE hr.total_assess > 0 AND hr.highrisk::numeric / hr.total_assess > 0.20
